## Spec (binding — Kimi design)
- Module `scripts/fleet_comms/cold_start_board.py`: fail-open probes `{status, elapsed_ms, error, data}`; never raise out of probe.
- CLI: `python -m scripts.fleet_comms cold-start-board [--format json|markdown] [--stream-id] [--agent] [--needle TOKEN]`
- Defaults: SESSION_STREAM_ID, SESSION_HANDOFF_AGENT
- Probes: capsule/session env, plane-status, backlog+dead-letters (best-effort current collectors), bottleneck slice if cheap, orient lean (timeout short), issues/streams membership if API up, session_streams tail + handoff-status (RO only — never handoff-claim), entire status + optional one-needle search, inbox check for agent, optional gh pr list if gh present
- Caps: strings ≤200, lists ≤5, board ≤16KiB, truncated marker
- Exit 0 if board emitted (even degraded); no lease claim; no writes; no POSTs
- WP-D: document bootstrap-git recipe in runbook (closed issue cannot bootstrap-github-issue); single-token needles; do not invent SHAs in code
- Tests: all_probes board structure; probe failure degrades; size cap; no claim/write calls; markdown path if implemented

Worktree: `.worktrees/dispatch/agy/cold-start-pr2-board/` branch `agy/cold-start-pr2-board`.

Implement → pytest → ruff on py files → commit `X-Agent: agy/cold-start-pr2-board` → push → PR to #4707 → no auto-merge.

## Constraints
- <20 files; do not change efficiency_metrics (PR-3); do not rewrite drive-epic (PR-1)
- Prefer imports over shelling to self where possible
- #M-4 evidence
